facts.content: Patient reports dyspnea with possible chest tightness associated with the current episode.

facts.content: Asthma is present as a baseline condition managed with salbutamol only.
Plan is to immediately call 999 and arrange EMS transport to the emergency department.

facts.content: Administer oral antihistamine on-site if available while awaiting EMS.

facts.content: Advise that in the emergency department the patient will likely need intramuscular adrenaline, airway monitoring, steroids, and a nebulised bronchodilator.

facts.content: After discharge, prescribe two EpiPens and arrange an allergy clinic appointment for shellfish and peanut testing and an action plan.

facts.content: Reinforce use of salbutamol and consider adding a preventer inhaler at GP review.
